API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIAdministrationGets configured departments
Gets configured departments
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/administration/departments

Gets configured departments.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

q
string

The search string used to support search by name or department ID.

Responses
​
200
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
integer

The department ID.

name
string

Name of the department.

]
